description_en: Creates a consumer group for AMQP server-side subscriptions
description_zh: 调用该接口创建一个消费组，用于创建AMQP服务端订阅
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-consumer-group --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --group-name '消费组1' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character is counted as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 消费组名称。支持中文汉字、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度为4~30个字符，一个汉字计为两个字符
parameters.name: group_name
